answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil control by making correlated equivocation costly: when k identities coordinate conflicting votes, the attributable penalty grows as O(k^2), debiting bonded collateral and escalating with each linked fault. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss for the controlling entity, so adding velvet, quartz, or comet-named identities increases exposure rather than influence; asymmetric depreciation further erodes recoverable stake.
